name: manual_c709f6
claim: Windows Task Scheduler rejects [TimeSpan]::MaxValue as a RepetitionDuration - it serializes to P99999999DT23H59M59S which the XML schema rejects

decisions.notes: Register-ScheduledTask failed on install_coord_pulse.ps1 with 'task XML contains a value which is incorrectly formatted'. Fix: New-TimeSpan -Days 3650 instead of MaxValue.

rationale: Register-ScheduledTask failed on install_coord_pulse.ps1 with 'task XML contains a value which is incorrectly formatted'. Fix: New-TimeSpan -Days 3650 instead of MaxValue.
